_comment: Configuration of scripts/third-party-inventory.py. 'allowed' lists the licenses a dependency may use without a review; extend it only with a reason in 'allowed_why'.
title: Third-party dependencies of the launcher
intro: Every Rust crate and npm package the launcher pins in `launcher/src-tauri/Cargo.lock` and `launcher/package-lock.json`. The fonts, the programs shipped ready-built and what the install wizard downloads are described in [launcher/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../launcher/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); the engine has no package manager dependencies, and its third-party code is listed in [engine/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../engine/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

cargo.label: Launcher: Rust crates (Windows x64)
cargo.note: "runtime": linked into the launcher; "build": used only while compiling; "dev": tests and developer tools only, never linked into the launcher.

npm.label: Launcher: npm packages
npm.note: "runtime": bundled into the launcher's interface; "dev": build tools, not shipped; "optional": platform-specific builds of a tool, installed only on that platform.

allowed_why: Permissive licenses compatible with the project's MIT License, plus the SIL Open Font License for the bundled fonts. MPL-2.0 is a file-level license: the packages under it are used unmodified, and a change to one of their files would have to be published under MPL-2.0.
